summary: Iteration 14 - Testing 4 new features: Automated hashtags, Database limits, Data management, Category filter. Backend: 21/22 tests passed (95.5%). All new endpoints working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature 1 (Hashtags): extract_hashtags function working correctly - extracts relevant hashtags from content/title. New results will have hashtags, existing results don't (expected - feature added after they were created)

Feature 2 (Database Limits): GET/PUT /api/admin/database-limits working - admin can view/update user_max_results_limit (default 4000, range 100-10000). GET /api/ultimate-search/user-stats returns current_count, max_allowed, remaining, percentage_used

Feature 3 (Data Management): DELETE /api/ultimate-search/clear-all clears all user results. DELETE /api/ultimate-search/category/{id}/clear clears category results (including subcategories). DELETE /api/admin/clear-user-results/{user_id} and /api/admin/clear-user-category/{user_id}/{category_id} for admin
Feature 4 (Category Filter): GET /api/ultimate-search/category/{id}/results returns paginated results for a category with total count
Collate endpoint (/api/search/collate) enforces database limit - returns 400 if user has reached max_allowed results
All endpoints have proper authentication and authorization checks
seed_data_creation: Test categories created and cleaned up during testing
